services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Our sailing catamaran is the ideal vessel for your Naples boat tour, designed to provide a comfortable and enjoyable sailing excursion for up to 20 guests. This 42-foot catamaran is fully equipped with features that ensure a relaxing and memorable experience on the beautiful waters of Southwest Florida. Our catamaran boasts comfortable bow seating perfect for sightseeing, sunbathing, and watching for dolphins on a Naples dolphin tour. The unique combined cockpit and saloon offer both outside and inside seating options, providing protection from the elements while keeping you connected to the stunning scenery. The cruises offer opportunities to spot dolphins, find seashells, and relax with Gulf views. Special occasions and corporate events can be hosted with customized boat charters.

quotes.author: Tammy Dawson
quotes.text: We had an amazing time! The catamaran was immaculate and the crew was great!! The booking lady, Captain and First Mate were very friendly and professional! Extremely relaxing and beautiful. Saw dolphins, the gulf and anchored at a remote island. Enjoyed the drinks, awesome they were included. I could do this everyday and will definitely be booking again the next time we’re back to Marco. Highly recommend, you will not be disappointed!!

quotes.author: Kelly Dunne
quotes.text: My (now) fiancé and I took the private pontoon cruise with Captain Dave and it was absolutely perfect. We cruised around Marco Island while Captain Dave told us interesting facts about the area. We were taken to a small island to watch the sunset and Captain Dave was able to capture our engagement on video for us to have forever. We highly highly recommend this cruise, it couldn’t have been more perfect!

quotes.author: Emily Bradbury
quotes.text: Captain Stephen was the best! If you want a high quality professional catamaran tour this is it! The best time! The best morning and afternoon. Made our vacation ️ ️ ️ ️ ️ Wonderful memories! Always felt safe and the first mate Benjamin entertained and always made sure our drinks were full! A must if staying in Marco!!!

quotes.author: David Wright
quotes.text: Captain Dave took 5 of us out for the morning 2.5 hour cruise – Captain Dave was excellent – very knowledgeable and patient answering all of our questions. Captain Dave provided a lot of information about the wildlife and conservation rules and regs! A great trip and a great value!! We will return.

quotes.author: Ann Mackey Soldano
quotes.text: Captain Kelly was wonderful as was the first mate. They made certain we had everything we needed, and the boat was spotlessly clean. I highly recommend this for any catamaran cruise. It was wonderful. Great music too!!!

quotes.author: Susan Plautz
quotes.text: Captain Kelly was a wonderful host. The catamaran was beautiful, the music was good, the cocktails were tasty and we were lucky enough to see some dolphins and a beautiful sunset.

quotes.author: Jack Mautner
quotes.text: my wife and I were on Cap’n Dave’s 3 hour tour. unlike gilligan and the skipper we returned with big smiles. he did a wonderful job!!!!! enuf said.

quotes.author: Carla Aukett
quotes.text: Thank you Captain Dave for a lovely evening! We did the private pontoon sunset cruise to celebrate a 50th wedding anniversary. We had a great ride around Marco Island and the Isles of Capri. Saw dolphins, many Osprey in their nests and a pair of manatees swimming up the river. A wonderful experience as we toasted to the happy couple and the beautiful sunset. We have also done the catamaran sunset cruise twice and highly recommend this company for their professionalism. Boats are clean, crew operates with the highest safety standards and they are extremely hospitable.
